records.name: bridge_and_threshold
records.operational_use: Require entry and exit criteria for every procedural transition.

records.name: mountain_and_paths
records.operational_use: Allow multiple methods while comparing their evidence, cost and failure modes.

records.name: map_and_territory
records.operational_use: Never promote a semantic map into identity with the represented reality.

records.name: compass_and_weather
records.operational_use: Keep stable principles while adapting execution to observed conditions.

records.name: medicine_and_dose
records.operational_use: A useful mechanism can become harmful when dose, context or contraindication is ignored.

records.name: scale_and_weights
records.operational_use: Use declared weights and apply them symmetrically to favored and disfavored claims.

records.name: garden_and_pruning
records.operational_use: Growth includes removal, but every removal requires reason and recoverability.

records.name: fire_and_tending
records.operational_use: Do not universalize a community image without a community-specific source.

records.name: potter_and_clay
records.operational_use: Record how material constraints shape form and how revision leaves provenance.

records.name: breath_and_sail
records.operational_use: Infer hidden causes only through bounded observable effects and alternatives.

records.name: echo_and_canyon
records.operational_use: Distinguish original signal from amplification created by the environment.
